title: Agent uses widget chart.line
prompt:
Write a Viva artifact that uses a TOP-LEVEL `widget chart.line` declaration.

CRITICAL SYNTAX:
- Write `widget chart.line` at the same indentation as `scene` / `data` (NOT `widget: chart.line` inside scene/layer).
- Widget body: `data:`, `xField:`, `yField:`, `xlim:`, `ylim:`, `areaX:`, `areaY:` (pairs of numbers, e.g. `areaX: 40 440`).

Include a data series of at least 4 {x,y} points.
Output ONLY valid Viva source starting with artifact.
